name: Love
description: A cinematic, mobile-first digital love letter — rose gold on midnight.
author: Digital Greeting

fields.headline: For you, who holds my heart
fields.subtitle: A small universe of moments we share — written here, for you.
fields.welcome_title: A love letter, in the quiet
fields.welcome_prompt: Scroll gently. It was made only for you.
story_paragraphs: It began in an ordinary room, but nothing after that in me was ever ordinary. Not the way you said hello, not the pause before your laugh — and certainly not the quiet hours afterwards in which I wanted to tell you everything.
Since then, every everyday has earned its gold edge. The run you share, the books you never finish, the walk that always finds its way past your window. None of it is small. All of it is us.
You are the reason I fold the future like a love letter.
fields.quote_text: I have loved you the way a candle loves the night it warms — without needing to be seen, and shining anyway.
fields.gallery_subtitle: Tap any frame to fall into it.

photos.caption: Golden hour, the first time we noticed
A Sunday that felt like a holiday
Rain — and nowhere we had to be
The beginning of a long, lovely road

fields.video_caption: Replace this frame with your favourite clip of us.
fields.message_title: A message, kept just for you
special_message: I have written this letter a thousand times and it never arrives the same way twice. The short version is: you make my favourite. You make the hard weeks softer, the good ones longer, and the silence kinder.
Whatever today is for you — loud, quiet, golden or hard — you are not carrying it alone. I will always look for you first in the room, and hold out my hand in the crowd.

music_meta.title: Our Song
music_meta.artist: a melody only you can hear

fields.music_note: It plays softly the whole way down the page — tap the note to start if your browser waits for you.
fields.countdown_subtitle: Because every second gets a title.
fields.reasons_subtitle: The list is endless — these are the ones I wrote before you woke up.

reasons.title: The way you listen
reasons.text: You don't just hear people. You understand them mid-sentence.

reasons.title: Your quiet courage
reasons.text: You make brave look like a kind decision.

reasons.title: Your laugh
reasons.text: It resets my entire nervous system, instantly.

reasons.title: The softness you keep
reasons.text: You hide it, but I always find it.

reasons.title: How you love
reasons.text: Like a language you were born fluent in.

fields.timeline_subtitle: Ordinary steps, extraordinary by the end.

timeline.title: The hello
timeline.text: Across a café table — same hopeless order, same wrong opinion.

timeline.title: The first real talk
timeline.text: We stayed past all our good hours and discussed everything that mattered.

timeline.title: Our first adventure
timeline.text: A lost road, a ruined day, a view neither of us has ever forgotten.

timeline.title: Every day I choose you
timeline.text: And I would choose it again, in every universe that has a us in it.

fields.surprise_message: Will you keep writing this story with me? Every ordinary miracle, every chapter. I love you — today, tomorrow, and in every universe parallel to this one.
fields.closing_message: Whatever this letter becomes, it was written true.
fields.footer_note: Made by hand, for your eyes only
